_comment: Press/trading names that differ from the registered name in universe.csv. Without an entry the relevance test scores that company's news 0 and the name goes dark on its card. Only names EVIDENCED in real fetched headlines are listed - a guessed alias creates false matches, which is the failure this whole layer exists to stop. Keys beginning with _ are ignored. Add a symbol when a card reads 'no news' for a company you know is in the papers.
